reason: A DSH web interface plugin that visually replaces selected Chinese and English speaker pronouns with a blue whale icon while preserving underlying message text and excluding inputs, code blocks, and quoted text.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 对话中的指定说话者人称以蓝色鲸鱼图标显示，同时保留原始文本内容。
summaries.en: Visually replaces selected speaker pronouns in DeepSeek Harness conversations with a blue whale icon while preserving the original text.

capabilities: Changes the visual rendering of selected speaker pronouns in DSH conversation messages
Injects a custom color font and browser-side DOM display logic
Observes interface changes to apply visual substitutions
Provides an optional local font adjustment script
